notes: mavros sends MAVLink SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET from two plugins: setpoint_attitude (setpoint_attitude.cpp:91-105; inputs ~setpoint_attitude/attitude geometry_msgs/PoseStamped, ~setpoint_attitude/cmd_vel geometry_msgs/TwistStamped, ~setpoint_attitude/att_throttle std_msgs/Float64, or TF frame_id->child_frame_id when tf/listen is true) and setpoint_raw (setpoint_raw.cpp:166-183; input ~setpoint_raw/attitude mavros_msgs/AttitudeTarget). All nine fields are filled positionally in mavlink_msg_set_attitude_target_pack_chan; target_system/target_component come from UAS_PACK_TGT (uint8_t getters, params target_system_id/target_component_id default 1, mavros.cpp:45-46). The MAVLink message definition (common.xml / generated mavlink headers) is not in the snapshot and is not an allowed .msg/.srv/.action/.idl dependency file, so definition_id is null and the field types 'as written in the definition' could not be read; therefore no provided element is placed in declares, and none in not_declared (the code does pack and send every one of them). For reference only, mavros's own send-wrapper parameter types are: time_boot_ms uint32_t, type_mask uint8_t, q float[4], roll/pitch/yaw rate float, thrust float (setpoint_attitude.cpp:91-95; setpoint_raw.cpp:166-170 uses Eigen types converted to float[4]/float).
